purpose: Converts Mythos Gates: Ascension into an Unreal Engine 5-first avatar-based, zone-based dungeon-crawler tactical RPG framework while preserving existing Lore Codex, Mythos Gates, factions, realms, deities, progression, combat, and mobile-first goals.
unrealSystems: World Partition when it provides real mobile loading benefit
dataDrivenRules: No hardcoded campaign, deity, encounter, reward, ability, enemy, or zone content.
Canon remains upstream source of truth.
Unreal assets consume stable Mythos Gates IDs as Primary Asset IDs.
Exploration and combat are modular zone products, not open-world sprawl.
AI-assisted generation assembles approved modules one stage at a time.

deityScaleRules.cameraMandate: Exploration shows deity scale; combat prioritizes tactical readability.

rules: source assets and game-ready imports remain distinct
collision and LOD metadata are required before production import

exploration: scale landmarks always visible where practical

mobileFirstMandate.rule: Build mobile-first from the beginning; do not build high-end first and downscale later.

playerControlRule: The player controls one divine Avatar at a time — a projection of their chosen Deity. Never armies, squads, soldiers, or multiple playable characters simultaneously.
deityGateCanonRule: Mythos Gates remain central and unchanged as established Lore Codex canon: ancient dimensional reality-structures, Gate states, Ascension Collapse scars, Realm roads, mission sites, dungeon entrances, and boss arenas.
dungeonCrawlerCanonExtension: NEW CANON EXTENSION: zone routes are treated as dungeon-crawler paths through existing Mythos Gate roads, ruin gates, distortion gates, sealed gates, and wound gates.
